summary: Mapped in OpenStreetMap as a lattice observation tower at 134 m; no history, staffing or status source found, so no story was written.

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap tags the structure as lattice construction
OpenStreetMap tags the tower type as observation

notes_for_editor: Brief: coordinates 32.000959, -90.602465; elevation 134 m; county not recorded. The only source is the OpenStreetMap node (tags man_made=tower, tower:type=observation, tower:construction=lattice, gnis:feature_id 711249). Two web searches returned no source describing a Hoodtown tower; the Redfin and Wikipedia hits concern a road and a town list. The NHLR Hinds Lookout Tower (US 1659, MS 24; N 32.228481 W 090.366939; 100 ft Aermotor, Mississippi Forestry Commission) is about 34 km away and is a different site. No story was written: beyond the tags and coordinates there is nothing an honest story can rest on. Next step: a county or Mississippi Forestry Commission lookout list, or a local place name, before a story is attempted.
